title: SpendPredicateV1
description: A reusable rule over one or more Spend Attestations. Downstream of attestations: a Spend Predicate does not create spend truth and does not mint Spend Attestation Tokens. Unreleased draft schema (object-model artifact, board step OM4).
$comment: Derived from 04-condition-layer/condition.md ('A Spend Predicate is a rule over one or more Spend Attestations. Spend Predicates are downstream of attestations: they do not create spend truth and they do not mint Spend Attestation Tokens.') and 04-condition-layer/condition-evaluation.md ('Evaluation MUST bind the predicate parameters, version, scope, verifier policy, and replay/nullifier rules where payment or settlement depends on the result.'). `predicateId`/`predicateHash` field shapes reuse the exact `$defs` already declared for CampaignEpochV1 (schemas/experimental/campaign-epoch.v1.schema.json: Identifier = {type: string, minLength: 1}; Sha256Id = {type: string, pattern: ^sha256:[a-f0-9]{64}$}), where `predicateId` is optional on the epoch (a reference) but required here (this schema defines the predicate itself, not a reference to one). `evaluationContext` reuses the parameters/version/scope/verifier-policy/replay-nullifier vocabulary from condition-evaluation.md rather than the narrower CBSA/store-exclusion shape in 06-extensions/offer-delivery-profile.md's PredicateDefinitionV1, which is a routing/distribution profile specialization, not the generic Rule-layer object. OPEN POINTS (see OM4 PR body): (1) `ruleExpression` is left open/minimal -- no normative document in this repository describes a boolean-composition or field-comparison grammar for predicate rules; condition-evaluation.md defers rule-composition detail to 04-condition-layer/campaign-commitment.md, which is itself campaign-profile-specific, not a generic Core/Rule grammar. (2) `evaluationContext.verifierPolicyRef` names the 'verifier policy' condition-evaluation.md requires evaluation to bind, but no normative source ties it to this same OM4 slice's `VerificationPolicy` artifact; that binding is undefined.

predicateId.description: Stable identifier for this predicate (04-condition-layer/condition.md; CampaignEpochV1's Identifier $def).

predicateHash.description: Content address of the canonicalized predicate: sha256: + lowercaseHex(SHA-256(RFC8785_canonicalize(predicate))). Field shape matches CampaignEpochV1's Sha256Id $def (schemas/experimental/campaign-epoch.v1.schema.json).

predicateVersion.description: Version bound during evaluation ('Evaluation MUST bind the predicate parameters, version, scope...', condition-evaluation.md).

evaluationContext.description: Scope and replay/nullifier binding required at evaluation time (condition-evaluation.md). Left open/extensible; this repository does not normatively define a fixed evaluationContext shape shared across all predicate uses.

scopeId.description: The declared scope evaluation MUST bind (condition-evaluation.md).

verifierPolicyRef.description: Reference to the verifier policy bound during evaluation (condition-evaluation.md's 'verifier policy'). OPEN POINT: no normative source ties this to VerificationPolicy.policyId from this same OM4 slice.

ruleExpression.description: OPEN POINT: this repository does not describe a generic rule-expression grammar for Spend Predicates (boolean composition, field comparisons, thresholds). Left open/extensible on purpose; do not treat this shape as complete.
